 ◢◤ ⇄ Host                                      
 Host interzone's files over IPFS               
 Help servers set up and update during a        
 blackout: the machine keeps the newest signed  
 copy of what interzone downloads and shares it 
 with interzone's IPFS swarm. It listens on TCP 
 port 4001 (open it in the firewall), and the   
 swarm's members can see that it holds Matrix   
 software.                                      
                                                
 ▌  What to host                                
 ▌   ◉ Everything (about 19 GB)                 
 ▌   ○ Container images only (about 15 GB)      
 ▌  Everything lets other servers set up from   
 ▌  scratch through yours: the playbook, OS,    
   ▼ more below
